faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to find your tribe, start your own and chat with peace of mind.
faq.q.free.a: Yes. Exploring tribes, chatting and creating your own costs nothing.
faq.q.account.q: Do I need an account to chat?
faq.q.account.a: No. You can join any tribe and chat with an anonymous name. With an account you can also save favorites, create tribes and have your own profile.
faq.q.find.q: How do I find a tribe?
faq.q.find.a: In <explore>Explore</explore>, search by name or topic (the shortcut is the / key) or filter by category. Each card shows how many people are online right now.
faq.q.create.q: How do I create my tribe?
faq.q.create.a: With your account, go to <create>Create tribe</create>: give it a name, a description and up to 3 categories. Then you can add a cover and an icon, or skip that step.
faq.q.review.q: Why does my tribe say "Under review"?
faq.q.review.a: We review every new tribe before it goes live, to make sure it follows the <guide>community guidelines</guide>. You can follow its status in <mine>My tribes</mine>.
faq.q.limit.q: How many tribes can I create?
faq.q.limit.a: For now, one per day. That way every new tribe gets the attention it deserves.
faq.q.rejected.q: My tribe was rejected, what now?
faq.q.rejected.a: Check that its name and description follow the <guide>community guidelines</guide>. From <mine>My tribes</mine> you can edit it or create another one.
faq.q.media.q: What can I send in the chat?
faq.q.media.a: Messages, emojis, photos, voice notes, GIFs and reactions. You can also reply to a specific message and mention someone with @.
faq.q.favorites.q: How do I save a tribe to come back later?
faq.q.favorites.a: Tap the heart on its card. You'll find it in <favorites>Your favorites</favorites> and in the sidebar.
faq.q.report.a: In the chat, open the member list and tap the report button next to their name. Tell us what happened and the moderation team will review it.
faq.q.email.a: Only you. Your public profile shows your name, photo, bio, location, hobbies and chat preferences, but never your email.
faq.q.profile.q: How do I change my name or photo?
faq.q.profile.a: In <profile>your profile</profile>, tap the pencil next to each detail or the camera on your photo.
faq.q.data.q: What do you do with my data?
faq.q.data.a: We explain it in detail in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
faq.cta_title: Want to know how we look after the tribes?
faq.cta_text: The community guidelines have the rules we all follow.
guide.title: We look after the tribes together
guide.subtitle: Tribuzz works because everyone feels welcome. These are the rules that help keep it that way.
guide.illustration_label: A bubble-shaped shield protects a group of Tribuzz characters.
guide.rule.respect.title: Respect everyone
guide.rule.respect.text: You can disagree, but without insults, harassment or mockery. We don't tolerate hate based on origin, religion, gender, orientation or anything else.
guide.rule.respect.do: I don't see it the same way, but I'm curious. Why do you think so?
guide.rule.content.title: No sexual or explicit content
guide.rule.content.text: Tribes are open spaces. Don't share sexual or violent images, audio or messages nobody asked for.
guide.rule.content.do: Anyone got photos from last night's concert?
guide.rule.spam.title: No spam or shady links
guide.rule.spam.text: Don't sell, don't advertise unasked and don't repeat the same message over and over. Shady links put everyone at risk.
guide.rule.spam.do: I made a list of movies on the topic, want me to share it?
guide.rule.privacy.title: Protect your data and others'
guide.rule.privacy.text: Don't share phone numbers, addresses, passwords or private information, yours or anyone else's.
guide.rule.privacy.do: I'm from Austin, anyone else around here?
guide.rule.privacy.dont: My number is 555 123 4567, text me now.
guide.rule.topic.title: Stay on the tribe's topic
guide.rule.topic.text: Every tribe exists because of a shared interest. Keeping the conversation on topic is what makes it worth coming back.
guide.rule.topic.do: Did you catch last night's meteor shower?
guide.report.title: See something that isn't right?
guide.report.text: Report it. It's quick and helps us act in time.
guide.report.step.open.title: Open the member list
guide.report.step.open.text: In the chat, open the panel with the people online.
guide.report.step.choose.title: Tap report and pick a reason
guide.report.step.choose.text: Harassment, hate, sexual content, spam or other. Add details if you like.
guide.report.step.review.title: Moderation reviews it
guide.report.step.review.text: The team reviews every report and decides what to do.
guide.after.title: What happens next
guide.after.accounts.title: With accounts
guide.after.accounts.text: If someone breaks these rules, moderation can suspend their account.
guide.after.tribes.title: With tribes
guide.after.tribes.text: Every new tribe is reviewed before it goes live. Those that don't follow these guidelines, in their name, description or topic, are rejected.
guide.cta_text: Find a tribe about what you love.
legal.cta_text: The FAQ answers the most common ones.
legal.terms.title: Terms of Service
legal.terms.intro: By using Tribuzz, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.
legal.terms.use.title: Use of the service
legal.terms.use.p1: Tribuzz is a platform for communication between people. You agree not to use the service for illegal purposes or in ways that break our <guide>community guidelines</guide>.
legal.terms.content.title: User content
legal.terms.content.p1: You are solely responsible for the content (messages, images, links) you post. We don't tolerate harassment, spam or non-consensual explicit content.
legal.terms.termination.title: Account termination
legal.terms.termination.p1: We reserve the right to suspend or delete accounts that repeatedly break our terms or for abusive behavior reported by the community.
legal.terms.liability.title: Limitation of liability
legal.terms.liability.p1: Tribuzz is provided "as is". We are not responsible for external interactions between users or for data loss beyond our technical control. Continued use of the app means you accept these terms.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.intro: At Tribuzz, our users' privacy is our priority. This policy describes how we collect, use and protect your information.
legal.privacy.collect.title: Information we collect
legal.privacy.collect.p1: We collect the information needed to run the service:
legal.privacy.collect.item1: Your account data: username and email. If you sign in with Google or Facebook, the name and email that service shares with us.
legal.privacy.collect.item2: Profile data you choose to add: photo, bio, location, age range, hobbies and chat preferences.
legal.privacy.collect.item3: What you share in tribes: messages, photos, voice notes and reactions, and the tribes you create.
legal.privacy.collect.item4: Reports: the reports you send about other users and their reason.
legal.privacy.usage.title: How we use it
legal.privacy.usage.item1: Provide and maintain the chat service.
legal.privacy.usage.item2: Notify you about changes to our platform.
legal.privacy.usage.item3: Let you take part in interactive features.
legal.privacy.usage.item4: Provide support and moderate the community.
legal.privacy.security.title: Data security
legal.privacy.security.p1: We implement security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration or disclosure. However, remember that no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
legal.privacy.rights.title: Your rights
legal.privacy.rights.p1: You can see and correct your profile data at any time from <profile>your profile</profile>.
legal.privacy.rights.p2: To request a copy of your data or delete your account and personal data, write to us at <mail>privacidad@tribuzz.chat</mail>.
legal.cookies.title: Cookie Policy
legal.cookies.intro: We use cookies so Tribuzz works properly. Here's which ones and what for.
legal.cookies.what.title: What is a cookie?
legal.cookies.what.p1: A cookie is a small text file saved in your browser. It lets us, for example, remember that you signed in.
legal.cookies.types.title: What we use
legal.cookies.types.p1: We don't use analytics or advertising cookies today. We only use:
legal.cookies.types.item1: Essential cookies: needed to sign in and keep your account secure.
legal.cookies.types.item2: Browser local storage: keeps your preferences, like language and light or dark theme. These aren't cookies and aren't sent to our servers.
legal.cookies.control.title: Managing cookies
legal.cookies.control.p1: You can turn off cookies at any time in your browser settings, but without the essential cookies you won't be able to sign in to Tribuzz.
